from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'universal_job_bridge.py'


def test_bridge_has_persistent_atomic_claim():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'CLAIMS = STATE / "claims"' in text
    assert 'os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL' in text
    assert 'except FileExistsError:' in text
    assert 'already_claimed(name) or not claim_once(name)' in text


def test_claim_is_not_removed_by_receive_or_dispatch_lifecycle():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    receive = text[text.index('def receive()'):text.index('def status()')]
    assert 'unlink' not in receive
    assert 'CLAIMS / name' not in receive or 'claim_once(name)' in receive
